Title: France Travail, “L'Aide individuelle à la formation (AIF)”
Notes: France Travail AIF page is current and states eligibility, PPAE alignment, approved training, and that the award may cover all or residual course fees only after review. It is not a universal language-training entitlement.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article L. 423-1, “Étranger conjoint de Français”
Notes: Légifrance Article L423-1 remains in force; current text sets the one-year spouse-of-French route and requires continuing community of life, spouse retaining French nationality, and prior French transcription of a foreign marriage.

Title: Ministry of Higher Education, “FAQ — Droits d’inscription différenciés pour les étudiants extra-communautaires”
Notes: MESR FAQ answers the 2026 decree on differentiated registration fees, effective 21 May 2026. It lists exemptions from differentiated fees, individual exemptions, 2026/27 amounts, and separate CROUS aid; TP is not identified as an automatic domestic-fee category.

Title: Caf des Yvelines, “Je suis déplacé(e) ukrainien(ne)”
Notes: CAF des Yvelines page gives a department-level list for Ukrainian nationals holding a six-month renewable APS-BPT, subject to scheme criteria; it expressly excludes ARS under that local guidance. It must not be generalized nationally.

Title: Ministry / Eduscol, “Centre académique pour la scolarisation des élèves allophones nouvellement arrivés … (Casnav)”
Notes: Eduscol content is current (Feb 2026) and describes CASNAV support, expertise and contacts. The legacy URL redirects to the current canonical URL, so update the record to that URL.

Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), Cerfa 15763*02, S1106 “Demande d’ouverture des droits à l’assurance maladie”
Notes: The official S1106 form is available and provides a standard application to open health-insurance rights. It is a form, not a source for the substantive PUMa eligibility rule or the Ukraine-specific prefecture–CPAM route.

Title: Service-Public (DILA), “Carte de séjour entrepreneur/profession libérale d’un étranger en France” (F35795)
Notes: Service-Public card page was verified 1 Jun 2026. It states principal, registered, viable, adequately resourced activity matching qualifications/experience, plus route-specific documents and licensing for regulated liberal professions.

Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), “L’Assurance Maladie active ses dispositifs d'accompagnement auprès des personnes venant d’Ukraine”
Notes: Ameli Ukraine page was updated 10 Mar 2025 and describes immediate PUMa/CSS/no-advance-payment for 12 months for arrivals after 24 Jan 2022, plus child rules and contact routes. This is Ukraine-specific and contains some historical sub-sections; do not generalize to all TP holders.

Title: European Commission / EURES, “Help and support”
Notes: EURES Help and Support page describes adviser information, guidance and placement for jobseekers/employers and EU labour mobility. It is cross-border EU support, not a France-specific registration or offer-exhaustiveness authority.

Title: France Travail, “Premier entretien France Travail”
Notes: France Travail first-interview page describes diagnostic discussion, personalized accompaniment and planning job-search actions/workshops after registration. It does not establish a legal institutional designation or guaranteed service access.

Title: France Éducation international, “Centre ENIC-NARIC France” brochure
Notes: France Éducation international ENIC-NARIC brochure remains officially indexed; official content says protection-status applications receive priority and free handling with proof. It is not binding recognition/admission.

Title: OFII, “Formulaire de demande de prolongation des droits à l’ADA” for APS-BPT holders
Notes: OFII document is a May 2024 ADA-rights extension form for APS-BPT holders, not a current initial-claim checklist. Targeted official search found no single replacement continuation form; retain only as historical/transition procedure evidence.

Title: France Travail, “Offres d'emploi” / job-search help on France Travail
Notes: France Travail vacancies search is an active public listing/search service, including partner offers when selected; search access does not register a jobseeker or establish the completeness of vacancies.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article L. 412-1, “Détention préalable d’un visa de long séjour”
Notes: CESEDA L412-1 is in force and sets the default long-stay-visa requirement for the first issuance of temporary or multi-year residence cards, subject to international commitments and statutory exceptions.

Title: Assurance Maladie (ameli.fr), “Demander sa carte Vitale : conditions et démarches”
Notes: Ameli card page updated 14 Oct 2026: a Carte Vitale may be ordered only once affiliated and health rights are open; while waiting, an attestation of rights can prove those rights. It does not explain NIA/NIR civil-status requirements.

Title: France Travail, “Formulaire d'enregistrement des déplacés ukrainiens”
Notes: France Travail Ukraine profile form is accessible and collects APS dates, local address, work interest and registration status. It proves a Ukraine-specific intake/profile channel, not the general public-employment-network status or benefit eligibility.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA, Article D. 581-7
Notes: Current CESEDA D581-7 text remains in force through Oct 2026; it ties ADA to the duration of TP, applies asylum-allowance rules and ends payment on expiry/transfer. Its pinned June 2026 URL contains the same operative text.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article L. 423-7, “Étranger parent d’un Français”
Notes: CESEDA L423-7 remains in force; parent of a French minor route requires effective maintenance/education contribution since birth or for at least two years and waives the L412-1 visa condition.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Quelles solutions d’hébergement existent pour les personnes en situation de précarité ?” (F2003)
Notes: Service-Public emergency accommodation page verified 6 Aug 2026 lists 115 as free and 24/7 and outlines general emergency/accommodation orientation. It is not a Ukraine-specific or guaranteed placement route.

Title: France Travail, “Comment postuler à une offre partenaire qui m'intéresse ?”
Notes: France Travail partner-offer FAQ explains how to apply to partner listings and warns the application can proceed through the partner site. It is scoped to such offers, not general vacancy registration.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Discrimination à la location d’un logement” (F14750)
Notes: Service-Public page was verified 5 Nov 2026; it lists protected grounds in rental selection and says objective criteria such as financial situation may be considered. It does not set lease terms or allowed rental-file documents.

Title: Etudiant.gouv.fr / CROUS network, “Accueil des étudiants ukrainiens”
Notes: Etudiant.gouv Ukraine page includes 2026 intake instructions: applicants should contact the chosen institution directly, then the institution directs them to CROUS support. It is annual and Ukraine-specific.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article L. 426-17
Notes: CESEDA L426-17 remains in force and requires five uninterrupted qualifying years on specified residence cards, stable/sufficient resources at least SMIC (with exceptions) and health insurance for the long-term EU resident card. APS time is not listed as a qualifying permit category.

Title: Ministry of National Education, “Règlement type départemental des écoles maternelles et élémentaires publiques”
Notes: The 2014 education circular remains the official model for primary-school regulations and expressly says education is a right irrespective of migration status; mairie enrollment certificate followed by school admission, with provisional admission if documents are missing.

Title: Service-Public, “Allocations familiales (famille de 2 enfants ou plus)”
Notes: Service-Public family-allowance page verified 1 Jun 2026; it gives the general two-dependent-children-under-20 threshold and residence/status requirements for foreign nationals. It does not establish a blanket APS-BPT exclusion for ARS.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Rédaction du bail d’habitation (contrat de location)” (F920)
Notes: F920 is official but last verified 6 Jun 2025; the required residential-lease templates changed from 1 Oct 2026 and the information notice changed from 18 Oct 2026. Existing rent/term/deposit/state-of-entry clauses remain relevant, but the page needs review against the 2026 official update.

Title: Cnaf, Letter LR 2022-021, “Allocataires bénéficiaires de la protection temporaire”
Notes: CNAF LR 2022-021 remains cited by 2025 network instructions and 2026 guidance. It documents Ukraine TP benefit-specific derogations, CAF NIA handling, family-benefit eligibility, APL conditions and RSA/Prime five-year rule exceptions; scope remains TP and dated instructions.

Title: Service-Public, *Autorisation de travail d'un salarié étranger en France*, APS « protection temporaire - Ukraine » section
Notes: Service-Public work-authorization page is current and explicitly states APS protection temporaire–Ukraine authorizes work, exempts employer application, and gives prefecture-authenticity verification at least 2 working days before hiring; not self-employment or pending/expired APS.

Title: Service-Public / DILA, “Études supérieures : première inscription d’un étudiant”
Notes: Service-Public first higher-education registration page verified 6 Nov 2026; procedure depends on programme/applicant, lists Parcoursup routes and advises institution-specific registration for courses outside Parcoursup. It does not contain the Ukraine-specific 2026 admission instructions.

Title: Service-Public, *Faire reconnaître en France un diplôme obtenu à l'étranger*
Notes: Service-Public foreign diploma page is current and says the receiving institution decides recognition/admission; the ENIC-NARIC comparability opinion has no legal value and is not binding. Regulated professions are outside a general comparability opinion.

Title: France Travail, “Des partenaires pour vous proposer plus d’offres d’emploi”
Notes: France Travail current partner-offer page explains that partner listings may be offered through third-party sites and their conditions vary; it does not establish general France Travail registration or job guarantee.

Title: France Travail, “Je suis travailleur étranger : puis-je m’inscrire à France Travail ?”
Notes: France Travail foreign-worker registration page is current; adults 19+ need a valid French stay document that authorizes salaried work, including an APS if it carries that work authorization. It does not itself identify APS-BPT; pair with F2728 for that status.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA Article L. 412-2
Notes: L412-2 remains in force and provides an enumerated list of exemptions from the L412-1 long-stay-visa requirement; it is a specific list rather than a general APS-BPT exception.

Title: Légifrance, CESEDA, Article L. 581-9
Notes: L581-9 remains in force; TP beneficiaries can receive ADA subject to age/resource conditions. It does not specify the current monthly rate, detailed application checklist or automatic payment. The URL is a historical consolidation snapshot but the same provision remains current.

Title: Légifrance, Code de la santé publique, Article R1112-13
Notes: The linked section is an official current title page, but the exact cited Article R1112-13 has a direct canonical article URL. Article text requires urgent care and admission even without civil-status or reimbursement information; it says nothing about emergency phone numbers or charges.
